name: barbell clean and jerk
description: Lift a barbell from the floor to your shoulders, then drive it overhead. A technical full-body lift for power and speed.
instructions: Set up over the bar with a flat back and hands outside your knees.
Pull the bar off the floor and catch it at your shoulders in a squat.
Stand up with the bar racked.
Dip slightly and drive the bar overhead, splitting your feet.
Recover your feet, stand tall and lower the bar under control.
